title: Behold the Hand, Behold the Nail
notes: The chunk is dense, assertive, and law-positive: the picture-rule is stated cleanly, the Name is spelled without hedging, and the scripture chain (Zechariah, John, Isaiah, Psalm, Isaiah 49) lands with force. Residual house-style defects are concentrated in sentence openings (That/And/But) and two presenter residues (“must be weighed carefully,” “Now take”). One meta cross-reference (“this part has already weighed”) also breaks the no-meta rule. No doctrine, scripture wording, or symbol claims need touching; the fixes are purely local register and openers.

proposals.old: That square hand came back from Babylon with the exiles; before it, Israel and Judah wrote in the old script — the one still found cut into Hezekiah's tunnel, stamped on Judean seals and coins — and that script descends from the first alphabet the world ever had, scratched out in the mining camps of Sinai in the very age Israel served in Egypt.
proposals.new: The square hand came back from Babylon with the exiles; before it, Israel and Judah wrote in the old script — the one still found cut into Hezekiah's tunnel, stamped on Judean seals and coins — and that script descends from the first alphabet the world ever had, scratched out in the mining camps of Sinai in the very age Israel served in Egypt.
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not open with That. The square hand is the natural subject and keeps the claim intact.

proposals.old: And Scripture is conscious of its letters as letters: Psalm 119 walks the whole alphabet eight verses at a time, Lamentations weeps through it, the virtuous wife of Proverbs 31 is praised down its length.
proposals.new: Scripture is conscious of its letters as letters: Psalm 119 walks the whole alphabet eight verses at a time, Lamentations weeps through it, the virtuous wife of Proverbs 31 is praised down its length.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids And at the start of author prose. The sentence stands complete without it.

proposals.old: And God had already said where to look for the engraving:
proposals.new: God had already said where to look for the engraving:
proposals.rationale: Author prose may not open with And. The claim remains direct and assertive.
House style bars That as a sentence opener in author prose. The path is the clear subject.

proposals.old:
This layer must be weighed carefully: what it is, and what it is not.
It decides no doctrine; the verses above stand complete without a single picture.
But the Name was spelled in these four drawings on scrolls a millennium and a half before Golgotha — the hand, the beholding, the peg, the beholding — and when the event came, the witnesses wrote it down in exactly those terms: behold the hands, the print of the nails, look upon me whom they have pierced.
proposals.new:
This layer decides no doctrine; the verses above stand complete without a single picture.
The Name was spelled in these four drawings on scrolls a millennium and a half before Golgotha — the hand, the beholding, the peg, the beholding — and when the event came, the witnesses wrote it down in exactly those terms: behold the hands, the print of the nails, look upon me whom they have pierced.
proposals.summary: Cut weighing meta and But opener; assert the limit directly.
proposals.rationale: “Must be weighed carefully” and “what it is and is not” are director/meta staging. Merging removes the But violation and keeps the exact doctrinal limit the author already states.

proposals.old: Now take the letters to the sky.
proposals.new: Take the letters to the sky.
proposals.rationale: “Now take” matches the forbidden presenter staging list. The bare imperative preserves the author’s transitional voice.

proposals.old: The psalm of the cross carries the same wounds in the same members — __“they *pierced* my hands and my feet”__ — the verse whose one disputed letter this part has already weighed.
proposals.new: The psalm of the cross carries the same wounds in the same members — __“they *pierced* my hands and my feet.”__
proposals.summary: Drop meta cross-reference to prior weighing.
proposals.rationale: “This part has already weighed” is book-process meta-talk. The wounds claim stands complete without the aside.
